verdict.rationale: The pack documents Incident Workflows (if-this-then-that automation), escalation policies, and webhook events for incident responders. None of these shows defined incident roles such as commander or comms lead, or per-incident task checklists. Workflows and responder events are adjacent automation and notification features, not the role-assignment and checklist capability the story asks for.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, incidents carry defined roles (commander, comms lead) and task checklists so response stays coordinated under pressure
